articles.summary: Santander brings clients and industry leaders together in New York for third Americas Cash & Connectivity Forum.Santander hosted its third annual Americas Cash & Connectivity Forum in New York City, bringing together clients, partners and industry leaders to exchange perspectives on the forces reshaping treasury and cash management.
articles.title: 3rd Annual Americas Cash & Connectivity Day in NY

articles.summary: Santander CIB has received eight accolades at the 2026 Euromoney Transaction Banking Awards, extending the recognition achieved in 2025 and reflecting the continued development of its global Transaction Banking franchise.At the global level, Santander CIB was named World’s Best Trade Finance Bank, while in Latin America it received the title of Best Transaction Bank. The recognition extends across individual markets in Argentina, Brazil, Spain, US, Uruguay and Chile, including recognition for Cash Management across key markets.
articles.title: From local strength to global leadership: Euromoney recognises Santander CIB with eight outstanding Transaction Banking awards
